name: Allie Wett
source:
She had a friendly relationship with Riley and most of her classmates. She is the school's star swimmer and loves being in the water.

She has an outgoing personality, but can be a bit goofy from time to time. She really enjoys being around Riley. Is it possible that one day they become more than just friends?
